futures_champion#fc_secondary_field_rule.description: The 2027 NIT and College Basketball Crown slot rules (which conferences feed which event, NET cut-offs, automatic places for regular-season champions) and their history of declined invitations were not verified; the NIT and Crown rules text names only the champion.
futures_champion#fc_secondary_field_rule.what_would_resolve: Published 2026-27 NIT and Crown selection procedures and past invitation/decline lists.
futures_champion#fc_secondary_field_rule.classification_rationale: Verified (NCAA, 1 Oct 2026): the 2027 NIT shrinks to 24 teams; exempt bids go one each to the highest-ranked eligible team of the top-10 KenPom conferences, auto bids to non-NCAA regular-season champions with average metric rank <=125. cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model defines eligibility from NET rank only, so its rule table and required rank inputs are now wrong; 2027 Crown allocation is still unresearched.
futures_champion#fc_secondary_field_rule.catalog_action: Rewrite cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model measurement with the 2027 NIT rules (24 teams, top-10 KenPom-conference exempt bids, champion auto bids at avg rank <=125), add conference KenPom ranking and multi-metric average rank as required raw inputs, and research/record the 2027 College Basketball Crown conference allocation for futures_champion.

futures_seed_other#so_field_size.description: KXMARMADROUND names a 'Round of 76', which does not match a 68-team field; the 2027 format (field size, number of play-in games, which seed lines play in) changes at-large counts, bubble probabilities and the round labels the other series use.
futures_seed_other#so_field_size.what_would_resolve: NCAA announcement of the 2027 tournament format and the KXMARMADROUND market list.
futures_seed_other#so_field_size.classification_rationale: Verified: 2027 field is 76 teams (44 at-large, 12 Opening Round games of the 12 lowest at-large and 12 lowest auto-bid teams, First Four name dropped). futures_seed_other prices at-large/bubble and round-qualification series (KXMARMADROUND 'Round of 76') but does not attach cbb.tournament_field_format, so its input list is missing the format definition.
futures_seed_other#so_field_size.catalog_action: Attach cbb.tournament_field_format to the futures_seed_other record, record the verified 76-team structure (44 at-large, 12 Opening Round games, round labels) in its measurement, and update cbb.auto_bid_structure/committee seed-model text that assumes 36 at-large and a 68-team First Four.

player_rebounds_assists#ra_scorer_discre.description: The size of scorer discretion on assists across college venues is not verified; if material it adds a venue-specific bias to any assist prop that no attached input captures, and whether a free dataset reveals it is unknown.
player_rebounds_assists#ra_scorer_discre.what_would_resolve: Compare home and away assist rates by venue over three seasons from public game logs and test whether between-venue variance exceeds the null.
player_rebounds_assists#ra_scorer_discre.classification_rationale: The catalog already defines cbb.venue_scorekeeper_stat_bias for assists/blocks/rebounds and wires it to player_props, but the player_rebounds_assists record, whose assist props it targets, does not attach it; the record itself says no attached input captures venue assist bias. That is a wiring defect; the magnitude is then empirical.
player_rebounds_assists#ra_scorer_discre.catalog_action: Attach cbb.venue_scorekeeper_stat_bias to the player_rebounds_assists record inputs (secondary role, assists/rebounds) and add the venue-bias interaction to its mechanism text; magnitude testing stays with pr_scorekeeper_effect.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#coa.description: No input models simultaneous competing vacancies (other schools hiring in the same cycle) that bid for the same candidates; a rival opening at a higher-resourced school can take a candidate off the board.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#coa.what_would_resolve: Build a cycle-level vacancy table with school resources and link overlaps, then estimate candidate loss rates to rival openings.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#coa.classification_rationale: Competing simultaneous vacancies are a real mechanism stage (rival openings remove candidates); the record's own mechanism review says no input tracks the carousel, and none of the 16 attached inputs (search state, program resources, availability calendar) models rival openings.
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events#coa.catalog_action: Author a new input (e.g. cbb.concurrent_vacancy_competition: open vacancies in the same cycle, their resources/attractiveness rank and candidate overlap) and attach it to unreg:coaching_and_governance_events, with an interaction against cbb.program_hiring_resources.
